description: This file defines the ModulesAPI class, which is part of an API module for managing and retrieving information about different application modules in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing all modules, updating module statuses, and internal handling of configuration data. The class extends an Endpoint and implements CRUD operations for modules, utilizing traits and services related to modules, menus, and OAuth integration.

classes.name: ModulesAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class to manage application modules, allowing listing current module statuses and updating them through REST API calls. Includes integrated services and configurations specific to the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ModuleService.

methods.name: getConfigurableModulesArray
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of modules with their enabled/disabled status by combining static config with database and OAuth data.

methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; typical REST API method to fetch a single resource.

methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; validation rules for fetching one resource.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all modules with their statuses.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing all modules.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; creation of new modules is not supported.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the status of modules based on request parameters and invalidates related caches.
